validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="retries" expr="3"/></datamodel>
  <final id="a">
    <onentry>
      <assign location="$retries" expr="$retries-1"/>
    </onentry>
  </final>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `$retries-1` is one undeclared variable named `retries-1`, not `$retries` minus `1`
notes: an XPath variable exists only for a declared `<data id>` (and `<foreach item/index>` or `idlocation` names once they run) or a system variable; evaluating an undeclared one raises `error.execution`
diagnostics.help: `-` is part of an XPath name, so `$retries-1` is one variable; put spaces around `-` to subtract: `$retries - 1`
